map.死亡力和死亡率 q 关系？: Relation between force of mortality and mortality rate q?
map.qₓ = 1−pₓ = 1−e^−μ ≈ μ（μ 小的时候近似相等）；精确用 q: q_x = 1 - p_x = 1 - e^(-mu) ~ mu (approximate when mu is small); exact: q = 1 - e^(-mu).
map.死亡力为负有意义吗？: Is a negative force of mortality meaningful?
map.无意义。死亡力 mu 由负对数 p 得出，p（年生存概率）在0到1之间，故 mu: Meaningless. Force of mortality mu is from the negative log of p; p (annual survival probability) is between 0 and 1, so mu is not less than 0; a negative result means input p is greater than 1, check the data.
